taylor_all_songs |>
    filter(!is.na(album_name), !is.na(duration_ms)) |>
    mutate(minutes = duration_ms / 60000) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = minutes, y = album_name)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(
    y = "Song length (minutes)",
    title = "Taylor Swift song length \n by album",
    caption = "Source: TidyTuesday 2023-10-17 (taylor R package)"
  )

title: Davina Liu
text: My name is Davina Liu and I’m a current sophomore at Pomona College. My major is Applied Math and my minor is Data Science. I love creative writing (fiction and poetry), journaling/scrapbooking, and playing the piano.
